lines.t: Riding down the crooked path, the truth ignites my way,
The Words of fire burn in me, guiding night and day.
No change in this eternal voice, steady as the road,
Volumes of the sacred scrolls, their wisdom I unfold.
On my bike, racing with the wind so free,
Truth revs in every heartbeat, in God’s decree.
No turning back on this straight line, I’ll ride the flame,
Volumes of Truth my anthem, forever I proclaim.
Prophets’ echoes in the wind, their message rings so clear,
Answers only God can give, fueling every gear.
Each mile, a step in faith, the journey made divine,
I ride the Word that never bends, eternal and sublime.
On my bike, racing with the wind so free,
Truth revs in every heartbeat, in God’s decree.
No turning back on this straight line, I’ll ride the flame,
Volumes of Truth my anthem, forever I proclaim.
Through shadows and through light, the path is set by grace,
The Lord’s rebuke sets crooked ways to a holy place.
With every roar, I hear His voice clear and bold,
The Truth that rides beside me, never to grow cold.
On my bike, racing with the wind so free,
Truth revs in every heartbeat, in God’s decree.
No turning back on this straight line, I’ll ride the flame,
Volumes of Truth my anthem, forever I proclaim.
The crooked path made straight.
Ride on!
